# cpp-httplib

Source: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/tree/v0.18.7
Version: 0.18.7. MIT license; see LICENSE.
The header is formatted with this repository's clang-format 14 configuration.
Used only by the optional native CausalLM server and its tests. TLS and
compression backends are not enabled, so they add no external link dependency.
